coverage_delta: +46 notification tests (373 baseline -> 419 total). All UC-005 Lane A ACs covered by integration + pure unit tests.
post_review_fixes: Advisor review caught two real gaps (both fixed, full suite re-green): (1) AC#5 was passing with a FAKE 10-char token; the REAL minted token was ~72 chars making the production OrderCreated SMS 181-183 chars (two GSM-7 segments) with a 30-char fleet name. Fixed by right-sizing the UC-004 TrackingTokenService token: dropped the redundant outer base64 wrapper + truncated the HMAC sig to 128 bits (16 bytes) -> ~33-char token -> SMS ~144 chars. Symmetric Mint+Validate change, round-trip-safe (all TrackingTokenService tests are Mint->Validate; UC-004 PublicTrack tests stay green; tokens ephemeral, no migration). Extracted pure TrackingLink.Build shared by the job + AC#5 test so they cannot drift; AC#5 now mints a REAL token; PhoneOrderSmsEndToEnd also asserts GsmSevenValidator on the real body. (2) 90% FleetAdmin warning push (AC#6) was unwired (only the pure IsAtWarningThreshold flag + 100%-skip existed). Now NotificationService enqueues a SmsCapWarning push (new NotificationEvent.SmsCapWarning) to FleetAdmins when IsAtWarningThreshold trips; NotificationCapIntegrationTests asserts it.
notes: A1: ONE migration AddNotificationTablesAndSmsCap (--output-dir Infrastructure/Migrations) -> notification_outbox + notification_log + UNIQUE dedup index (FleetId,Event,OrderId,Recipient,Channel) + a (FleetId,OrderId) read index for A6 + FleetSettings.SmsMonthlyCapCzk(def 500)/SmsUnitCostCzk(def 1) via HasDefaultValue. Both entities ITenantEntity with global query filters. PushSubscription entity pre-existed (no migration). A2: POST/DELETE /api/v1/push/subscriptions, new AuthenticatedOnly policy (RequireAuthenticatedUser), upsert by (UserId,Endpoint) via IgnoreQueryFilters, DELETE via ExecuteDeleteAsync idempotent-204; plain-property request DTOs + validator (no `required`, STJ trap). A3: pure NotificationRouting (static matrix), SmsTemplates (Czech GSM-7 no-diacritics), PushTemplates, GsmSevenValidator (GSM 03.38 basic+extension set, septet count <=160), NotificationDedupKey; AC#5 class named NotificationSmsTemplateTests so the single-token filter catches it. A4 OUTBOX CALL-SITES: INotificationService.NotifyAsync injects the SAME scoped TaxiDbContext, only ADDS outbox rows (no SaveChanges, no new scope). Wired into OrderService.TransitionAsync BEFORE the single SaveChangesAsync (after OrderEvents.AddRange, before order.Version++) via MapTransitionToEvent; and into CreateOrderEndpoint BEFORE the public-code retry-loop save (OrderCreatedForCustomer always + NewAppOrderForDispatch when Source==App). CreateOrderRequest gained additive `OrderSource? Source`; endpoint sets Source = isCustomer ? App : (req.Source ?? Dispatcher). JsonStringEnumConverter already global (WI-09) so the Source enum deserializes from string - confirmed no Program.cs converter change needed. A5 WebPush PACKAGE: `WebPush` 1.0.13 used as primary - restores + builds CLEAN under -warnaserror on .NET 10, NO fallback to Lib.Net.Http.WebPush needed. ROUTING MATRIX: DriverArrived=SMS-always(+push if sub), RideStarted/Completed=push-only, App+no-push Created=SMS, Phone order=Created+Arrived SMS only, driver/dispatcher events=push. COST-CAP WINDOW: NotificationService counts Sent SMS log rows with SentAt >= first-of-month (TimeProvider) for the current-month spend; NotificationCostCap.Decide(sent,cap,unit,evt,channel): push Allow, DriverArrived Allow, else sent+unit>cap -> SkipCap; SkippedCap log row written directly in the engine (same DbContext). DEDUP TWO-LAYER: (1) enqueue does NOT dedup (outbox may hold dup rows); (2) SEND-boundary claim-then-execute - job INSERTs a notification_log row (Status=Queued) BEFORE the sender call; on a read-hit or 23505: existing row Sent/SkippedCap (terminal) -> skip send (duplicate), else Queued -> proceed (this row's own retry). STATUS-CHECK ownership resolves the advisor's retry-vs-duplicate tension WITHOUT a link column (one-migration honored). RETRY: 3 attempts, backoff 10s/30s/2m via TimeProvider, NextAttemptAt gates; Attempts>=3 -> outbox+log Failed. NotificationDispatchJob = RunTickAsync testable shell (PeriodicTimer ExecuteAsync); scan cross-tenant IgnoreQueryFilters, per-row fresh scope with CurrentTenant.FleetId set. SEND-TIME RENDERING: SMS body (absolute tracking link via TrackingTokenService.Mint + Notifications:PublicBaseUrl) rendered in the job, not at enqueue. Added NotificationStatus.Skipped (duplicate) - enum-as-string, no migration. A6: OrderDetailDto gained trailing-optional IReadOnlyList<OrderNotificationDto>? Notifications (default null) so all 3 construction sites compile; only GetOrderEndpoint populates it (AsNoTracking, tenant-scoped, OrderBy CreatedAt ThenBy Id). DEV VAPID: a real generated keypair is in appsettings.Development.json (VapidPublicKey/PrivateKey) + SmsProvider=Console + PublicBaseUrl=https://app.localhost; prod -> 08 (documented in decisions.md). TEST-FACTORY TRAP (fixed): NotificationTestFactory removes ONLY the hosted NotificationDispatchJob descriptor (not all IHostedService) so FakeTime.Advance in the 3x-fail test does not trigger extra PeriodicTimer ticks; tests drive RunTickAsync manually. OrderService ctor gained INotificationService - updated 5 existing OrderService test call-sites via a NoOpNotificationService double. OpenAPI allowlist updated (2 push routes) + docs/api.md regenerated by the suite test. DEFERRED (documented): 90-day push prune, ScheduledOrderReminder scan job, per-fleet matrix override, prod secrets, GoSms/SMSbrana live testing.
